newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices mixed at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices mixed at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices were mixed amid good demand at the weekly tea auction on Monday, auction officials said.

Brighter and medium BP1s were irregular while lower mediums eased by two U.S cents. Brighter PF1s were generally firm by four cents. Lower mediums PF1s were a strong feature while brighter and coloury mediums PDUSTs were firm by three cents. Other brighter sorts held steady.
Fannings and Brighter Dusts were generally dearer. Pakistan blenders were active, Egypt lent good support while Britain was more active. There was good enquiry from Sudan.
